correctness.rationale: The spectral bound 0≤H(I−H)≤I/4 and rank-one factorization give the scalar coefficient of P in the stated interval, and tI realizes all of it. Substitution of sP gives the logistic factor λ=σ²|v*u|²=|tr B|². Invariance forces any matrix probability onto J_σ and any scalar probability onto the image [0,λ/4] within that segment, proving that pushforward and restriction give inverse correspondences including λ=0. Choosing v in the span of u and a perpendicular unit vector gives exactly the full gain interval at fixed A. At the perpendicular endpoint the first image lies on J_σ and its next image is zero. At the aligned σ=2 endpoint the homeomorphism x=sin²(πt/2) from the full tent map pushes uniform measure to the stated arcsine law; the topological entropy is log 2. For any fixed separation scale, cover the compact full state space by finitely many sets of diameter less than that scale. Inside each such set a separated orbit set must separate after the first iterate, so its size is bounded by the separated-set size on J_σ for one fewer iterate. This proves the entropy upper bound from the segment as well as the lower bound by restriction; it does not assume that every point is chaotic or that the arcsine law is unique.
residual_risks: The supplemental extinction loop skips its only non-diagonal listed input because its determinant is negative; it is not an off-diagonal check as the frozen verification wording suggests. The analytic proof covers the full space. For instance, H with diagonal 1/2 and pure imaginary off-diagonal i/4 and its conjugate has H(I−H)=3I/16 and maps to 3P/4 and then zero at the perpendicular σ=2 endpoint.
B must have rank one; no general-rank invariant-measure classification is inferred.

value.rationale: Whether the positive matrix A suffices is a natural identifiability issue in the published model. The exact one-step reduction gives a complete sharp answer to which scalar laws are achievable by factors, not only to whether two different dynamics occur. The all-measure correspondence clarifies that the effective gain determines the entire invariant-probability problem in this rank, even though the factor can change the first iterate of general states. The familiar endpoint behavior is a useful illustration, not the value case by itself.
residual_risks: The utility is limited to the exact rank-one setting, not a predictive classification for arbitrary matrix couplings.
